name: December
summary: Holiday weeks carry the month at the warm parks. Great Adventure has announced a 2026 holiday event, but its exact dates remain pending; Great America has no announced December 2026 dates as of September 26.

verdict.short: December at these parks: holiday weeks are busiest at the warm parks. Check each northern park's published calendar before treating December as an operating month.

crowds.shape: Holiday weeks carry the month at the warm parks. Great Adventure has announced a holiday program with exact 2026 dates pending; Great America has no announced December 2026 dates as of September 26.
quietWindows: The first two weeks of the month

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: Christmas-to-New-Year week is often a peak at parks that are open, especially in warm regions. Check each park's December calendar before treating a holiday week as an operating week.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: The first two December weeks can be calmer than Christmas week at warm parks. Verify that the park and its holiday program are operating on your exact date.

freshness.sourceNote: Six Flags' 2026 holiday announcement names Great Adventure and Over Georgia, not Great America: https://www.sixflags.com/blog/holiday-in-the-park-returns. Great America's published events calendar ended with November 1 Fright Fest as of September 26: https://www.sixflags.com/greatamerica/events. Crowd and cost shapes are multi-year patterns, not a single-year forecast. Weather figures are regional climate normals.
